Rashi on Shabbat 91b:10:1.hebrew: הגונב כיס בשבת חייב - בתשלומין, ואע"פ שנדון בנפשו, שכבר נתחייב בגניבה בשעה שהגביה הכיס בבית הבעלים:
Rashi on Shabbat 91b:10:1.english: One who steals a purse on Shabbat is liable - for payment, even though he is judged for his life [i.e., liable to capital punishment], because he already became liable for theft at the moment he lifted the purse in the owner's house.

Rashi on Shabbat 91b:10:2.english: He was dragging [it] and exiting - [That is,] he did not acquire it through lifting, but rather through taking [it] out of the owner's house.

Rashi on Shabbat 91b:10:4.hebrew: שהרי איסור שבת כו' - ובכתובות פריך: אי דאפקיה לרה"ר, איסור גניבה ליכא, דרשות הרבים לאו מקום קנייה היא. ומוקי לה בצדי רה"ר, אי נמי שצירוף ידו למטה מג' וקבלה:
Rashi on Shabbat 91b:10:4.english: For the prohibition of Shabbat, etc. - And in [tractate] Ketubot, [the Gemara] asks: If he took it out into the public domain, there is no prohibition of theft, for the public domain is not a place of acquisition. And [the Gemara] establishes it [as referring to] the sides of the public domain, or else where he placed his hand below three [handbreadths] and caught it.

Rashi on Shabbat 91b:10:5.hebrew: קדים ליה איסור גניבה לאיסור שבת - דכיון שהוציאו מקצתו, קנה כל המעות שמבחוץ, שיכול להוציאו דרך פיו. ולענין שבת מפטר, דאגידי גבי רשות היחיד על ידי הכלי:
Rashi on Shabbat 91b:10:5.english: The prohibition of theft precedes the prohibition of Shabbat - For once he has taken part of it out, he has acquired all the coins that are outside, as he can take it out through its mouth. And regarding Shabbat, he is exempt, because they are connected to the private domain by means of the vessel.

Rashi on Shabbat 91b:11:1.hebrew: דרך שוליו - וכיון דלא מצי למשקל, לא קני בהגבהתו:
Rashi on Shabbat 91b:11:1.english: By way of its underside - And since he cannot take [the money], he does not acquire [it] by lifting it.

Rashi on Shabbat 91b:11:2.hebrew: הא איכא מקום חלמה - מקום התפירה, שיכול לקרוע ולהוציא. חלמה — שולדורא, כמו בהעור והרוטב (חולין קכג.): שאני עור דחלים:
Rashi on Shabbat 91b:11:2.english: Isn't there the area of the seam? - The place of the sewing, where he can tear [it] and take [the money] out. Chalamah [means] soldure [seam/join in Old French], as in [the chapter] HaOr VeHaRotev (Chullin 123a): "Skin is different, for it joins together [dechalim]."

Rashi on Shabbat 91b:1:1.english: Beyond the courtyard wall - To the perimeter of the cheil [rampart] that is in front of the Women's Courtyard, or to the Women's Courtyard, which is in the cheil.

Rashi on Shabbat 91b:1:2.hebrew: בהדי הדדי אתיין - דעד דאתנח ונצטרף עם השאר, (לא קבל טומאתו מן האויר דהא) לא הוי ביה שיעור:
Rashi on Shabbat 91b:1:2.english: They come simultaneously - For until it comes to rest and combines with the rest, (it does not contract its impurity from the airspace, for) it does not have the [requisite] measure.

Rashi on Shabbat 91b:2:1.hebrew: פשיטא - כיון דלא זרעיה, בטליה ממחשבה קמייתא, והוה ליה ככל אדם:
Rashi on Shabbat 91b:2:1.english: [This is] obvious - Since he did not sow it, he nullified it from [his] original intention, and he is like any [other] person.

Rashi on Shabbat 91b:2:2.hebrew: אמר אביי - מתניתין בשלא נמלך עליו בפירוש, אלא שזרקו לאוצר עם פירותיו, וזהו ביטול מחשבה מדלא אצנעיה לחודיה. ולמיתנייה איצטריך כגון שמקומו ניכר, שלא נתערב יפה עם השאר, והרי הוא ניכר ביניהם:
Rashi on Shabbat 91b:2:2.english: Abaye said - The Mishnah is [dealing with a case] where he did not explicitly change his mind about it, rather he threw it into the storehouse with his [other] produce, and this is a nullification of [his original] intent, since he did not put it away by itself. And it was necessary to teach [this] where its place is discernible, [meaning] that it did not become thoroughly mixed with the rest, and behold, it is discernible among them.

Rashi on Shabbat 91b:2:3.hebrew: מ"ד כיון דמקומו ניכר במילתא קמייתא קאי - דהוה ליה כמאן דאצנעיה לחודיה:
Rashi on Shabbat 91b:2:3.english: Lest you say [that] since its place is discernible it remains in its original [status] - For it is like one who stored it by itself.

Rashi on Shabbat 91b:2:4.hebrew: <abbr title="הכי גרסינן">ה"ג</abbr>: <abbr title="קא משמע לן">קמ"ל</abbr> מדזרקיה לאוצר, בטולי בטליה:
Rashi on Shabbat 91b:2:4.english: This is the reading: "[It] teaches us [that] since he threw it into the storehouse, he completely nullified it."

Rashi on Shabbat 91b:3:1.english: On the threshold - In the Gemara, [it] establishes it [as] a karmelit threshold.

Rashi on Shabbat 91b:3:2.hebrew: מלאכתו בבת אחת - עקירה ממקום חיוב והנחה במקום חיוב. [והכא] הוה ליה עקירה ממקום חיוב והנחה במקום פטור, והדר עקריה ממקום פטור ואנחיה במקום חיוב:
Rashi on Shabbat 91b:3:2.english: His labor all at once - [That is,] lifting from a place of liability and placing in a place of liability. And here there was lifting from a place of liability and placing in an exempt area, and then he lifted it from an exempt area and placed it in a place of liability.

Rashi on Shabbat 91b:3:3.hebrew: עד שיוציא - כלומר, אלא אם כן הוציא בראשונה כל הקופה, ובגמ' מפרש לה:
Rashi on Shabbat 91b:3:3.english: Until he carries out - That is to say, unless he initially carried out the entire basket, and in the Gemara [it] explains it.

Rashi on Shabbat 91b:4:1.hebrew: אי נימא איסקופה רה"ר - כגון גבוהה ט' ורחב ארבעה, ורבים מכתפין עליו, דחזיא לרבים לכתופי, כדאמר בפ"ק (דף ח.):
Rashi on Shabbat 91b:4:1.english: If we say [that] the threshold [is] a public domain - For example, [where] it is nine [handbreadths] high and four [handbreadths] wide, and the public rests loads [from their shoulders] upon it, for it is fit for the public to rest loads [upon it], as it says in the first chapter (8a).

Rashi on Shabbat 91b:4:2.hebrew: רשות היחיד - גבוהה י' ורחבה ד'. כי חזר והוציאה ליחייב, דאיכא עקירה מרה"י והנחה ברה"ר:
Rashi on Shabbat 91b:4:2.english: A private domain - [That is, it is] ten [handbreadths] high and four [handbreadths] wide. When he then carried it out, he should be liable, since there is lifting from a private domain and placing down in a public domain.

Rashi on Shabbat 91b:5:1.hebrew: אלא אסקופה כרמלית - מג' ועד ט' [ולא ט' בכלל], ואינה מקורה, ורחבה ד':
Rashi on Shabbat 91b:5:1.english: Rather, a threshold [that is] a karmelit - From three to nine [handbreadths high, and nine is not included], and it is not roofed, and it is four [handbreadths] wide.

Rashi on Shabbat 91b:5:2.hebrew: הא לא נח מיחייב - ואע"ג דהעבירו דרך כרמלית, ולא אמר מהלך כעומד דמי ואיכא הנחת גופו דהוי כהנחת חפץ:
Rashi on Shabbat 91b:5:2.english: [If] it did not come to rest, he is liable - Even though he passed it through a karmelit, [the Tanna] does not say [that] walking is like standing and [that] there is a resting of his body that is like a resting of the object.

Rashi on Shabbat 91b:5:3.english: From a store - [This is] a private domain.

Rashi on Shabbat 91b:5:5.hebrew: סטיו - מקום מוקף איצטבאות לישב, והוא כרמלית, דלא בקעיה ביה רבים להדיא:
Rashi on Shabbat 91b:5:5.english: A colonnade - A place surrounded by benches to sit [on], and it is a karmelit, since the public does not pass directly through it.

Rashi on Shabbat 91b:6:1.hebrew: קישואין ודילועין - שהן ארוכין, ועדיין יש מהם בפנים, וכל מה דאגיד לגואי כל דהו, לאו הוצאה היא:
Rashi on Shabbat 91b:6:1.english: Cucumbers and gourds - For they are long, and part of them is still inside, and whatever is connected to the inside [even] slightly is not [considered] carrying out.

Rashi on Shabbat 91b:6:2.hebrew: אבל מליאה חרדל - שהרי יש ממנו כולן בחוץ, אע"פ שעל ידי הכלי הוא נאגד לצד פנים, חייב, דאגד כלי לא שמיה אגד לומר לא יצא כולו ועדיין אגדו בידו בפנים. זהו לשון הש"ס לענין שבת: כל כמה דלא נפיק ליה כוליה קרי ליה אגוד, דאגודו שייך לגבי רשות קמא:
Rashi on Shabbat 91b:6:2.english: But [if it was] full of mustard - For some of it is entirely outside; even though through the vessel it is bound toward the inside, he is liable, because the binding of a vessel is not considered a binding to say [that] all of it has not gone out and its binding is still in his hand inside. This is the language of the Gemara regarding Shabbat: as long as all of it has not gone out, it is called "bound," for its binding pertains to the first domain.

Rashi on Shabbat 91b:8:1.hebrew: בד"א - דעד שיוציא את כל הקופה:
Rashi on Shabbat 91b:8:1.english: In what [case] is this statement said - [This refers to] "until he carries out the entire basket."

Rashi on Shabbat 91b:8:2.hebrew: במליאה קישואין - שהן ממלאין בארכן את כל רוחב הקופה, וכל כמה דלא נפק כולה קופה, לא נפיק אינהו:
Rashi on Shabbat 91b:8:2.english: In [a basket] full of cucumbers - For they fill the entire width of the basket with their length, and as long as the entire basket does not go out, they do not go out.

Rashi on Shabbat 91b:8:3.hebrew: ר' יוחנן מתרץ לטעמיה - תרתי קתני מתניתין, לא זו אף זו, דסיפא [מוכחא] דקתני "כל הקופה" ולא קתני "כל הפירות". והכי קאמר: "אף על פי שרוב הפירות מבחוץ", או אפילו כל הפירות מבחוץ, נמי פטור עד שיוציא כל הקופה:
Rashi on Shabbat 91b:8:3.english: Rabbi Yoḥanan resolves [the contradiction] according to his reasoning - The Mishnah teaches two things, [in the style of] "not only this, but even that"; for the latter clause proves [it], since it teaches "the entire basket" and does not teach "all the fruit." And this is what it is saying: "Even though most of the fruit is outside" — or even [if] all the fruit is outside — he is also exempt, until he carries out the entire basket.

Rashi on Shabbat 91b:9:2.hebrew: קס"ד בצררי - שהיה בה צרור של בשמים שחוקין, דכי אפקה למקצת קופה נפיק בההיא פורתא כמה צרורות כולן, וקתני פטור. אלמא אגד כלי שמיה אגד:
Rashi on Shabbat 91b:9:2.english: It might enter your mind [that it refers] to bundles - That there was in [the basket] a bundle of crushed spices, so that when he took out part of the basket, several bundles went out completely in that small [portion], and [yet the baraita] teaches [that he is] exempt. Thus, the binding of a vessel is considered a binding.

Rashi on Shabbat 91b:9:3.english: With urnasei - Bundles of long roots, or reed, or cinnamon bark, which are long.

Tosafot on Shabbat 91b:9:1.hebrew: קס"ד בצררי, קשיא לחזקיה - ואלימא ליה ממתני', משום דסתם קופת הרוכלים אית ביה צררי, וכ"מ מדקתני ובה מינין הרבה; ומשני באורנסי, ובה מינין הרבה — אורחא דמילתא נקט, וכל המינין ארוכים:
Tosafot on Shabbat 91b:9:1.english: "It might enter your mind [to say that this is referring] to bundles; [that] is difficult for Ḥizkiya" - And [this baraita] is stronger for him [as an objection] than the Mishnah, because an ordinary merchant's basket contains bundles, and so it is implied from what it teaches: "and in it are many kinds." And [the Gemara] answers: "[We are dealing] with stalks [urnasei]"; and [the phrase] "and in it are many kinds" — it [merely] stated the usual way of things, and all the kinds are long [stalks].
